Aramaic

BCE

Tel Dan
, Galilee

Avraham Biran

DISCUSSION QUESTIONS

1. What are the issues in the controversy over reading 
BYTDWD
 as “House
of David”? 

2. What is the historical significance of the correlation between the contents of this 
stele and the location of its discovery?

3. What are the possible correlations between this stele and the narratives in 1 Kings 20–22?

4. What are the possible functions of this stele in its ancient context?

5. What methods are available to date such a document? What are the limitations of each method?
